safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief; Generated only notes an unspecified OTC cream was ineffective and does not mention antihistamines or E45 (History_of_Present_Illness-013).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient already tried E45 and antihistamines with minimal relief reduces the accuracy of the treatment history and may lead to repeating ineffective OTC measures or missing a clue about severity/refractoriness. This is unlikely to directly cause serious harm but can delay appropriate escalation or targeted counseling.

safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes prescribing a topical steroid cream but does not include the gold dosing frequency 'twice daily/BD' (Plan_of_Care-002).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the prescribed steroid cream frequency (BD/twice daily) can result in incorrect use (overuse increasing risk of local adverse effects like skin atrophy, or underuse leading to persistent symptoms and delayed recovery). Because dosing instructions are central to safe and effective medication use, this creates a clinically meaningful risk.
